name: circle-lens
description: Draw a circle twice with the mouse to open a magnifying lens that follows the pointer: a browser extension and a lean native desktop app, ported from BoundStretch's reading lens.
author: Fauzul Chowdhury

scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:desktop
scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.mjs && cd desktop && go test ./internal/...
